about_the_game:
My friend and I loved Hotline Miami’s relentless, one-hit-kills combat but craved a sidescroller—so we built Rusalka Wrath around that same unforgiving intensity. Then we added the sweet BULLET TIME mechanic from Max Payne, letting you slow down each firefight to line up perfect headshots or dodge incoming bullets. Dive into a psychological mafia revenge saga set in New York’s Russian underworld, where every chapter grants a new, game-changing ability.

  • 🔥 Hotline Miami-style lethality – Fast, precision-demanding gunplay where one mistake costs you everything.

  • ⏱️ Max Payne-inspired bullet time – Temporarily slow the world to turn chaos into calculated kills.

  • 🎯 Unique ability per chapter – Explosive rounds, time-stopping bursts, piercing shots, and more; each level transforms combat.

  • 🎨 Manga-style in-game cutscenes – Stylized anime art drives home the emotional weight between gunfights.

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Psychological Russian mafia narrative – Betrayal, guilt, and power plays within New York’s criminal underbelly.

  • 💣 Throwables, bombs, and active skills – Combine grenades, Molotovs, and supernatural powers to stay alive.

  • 🏴‍☠️ Multiple mafia factions – Navigate a dangerous underworld populated by Chinese triads, the Russian cartel, the Italian mob, and more.

  • 🌃 Authentic urban noir setting – Navigate rain-slicked alleyways and smoky backrooms ruled by corrupt cops and ruthless mobsters.

Rusalka Wrath is more than just a shooter—it’s a brutal fusion of twitch reflexes, cinematic slow-mo, and a dark, character-driven story you won’t forget.
